summary: Issue 6990 asked for the container-registry module to expose the networkRuleBypassForTasks setting for ACR tasks. The original contributor PR 7158 was closed unmerged, and a rebase of it, PR 7280, was merged.
proposed: The issue says the avm/res/container-registry/registry module lacked a way to set networkRuleBypassForTasks. It says that without it, tasks such as image scanning cannot bypass network rules on firewalled or vnet-restricted registries.
changed: PR 7158 added support to bypass network rules for ACR tasks and was closed without review activity. PR 7280 was opened as a rebase of 7158 'to allow validation', keeping the original author's history. The change adds a bool parameter networkRuleBypassAllowedForTasks, default false, in main.bicep. PR 7280 shows one reopen and a dismissed review followed by an approval.
rejected: PR 7158 was closed without being merged; the slice shows no reviews or comments on it and gives no reason.
shipped: PR 7280 merged as commit f706d97. It adds the networkRuleBypassAllowedForTasks bool parameter (default false) to avm/res/container-registry/registry, with CHANGELOG and README updates.
